_doc: Cave Abode & Home Works (design/gdd/cave-abode.md, #47; CaveAbode). slots_by_grade: F3's work slots at grades 1-5; level_margin: F3's level ceiling above the grade (a work's level is at most min(its max, grade + level_margin)). grade_cost_frac: F1's raise cost to grades 2-5 as a share of the owner's realm budget (events_budgets linh_thach_max). upkeep_frac: F2's grade upkeep per season, grades 1-5, as a share of that budget (cut by Tho purity as map_works' tho_upkeep_cut_per_purity). grade_fade_seasons: consecutive unpaid seasons before the grade drops one (grade 1 never drops). claim_frac: F4's claim fee as a share of the opening fee (map_works abode_cost_frac). top_grade_by_realm: the highest grade a realm can hold (3 below Core Formation, 4 at Core Formation, 5 from Nascent Soul; the same minimums as map_works grade_realm_min). npc_reserve_mult, npc_raise_p: F5 (an NPC raises when its purse holds npc_reserve_mult x the next grade's cost and its keyed seasonal roll is below npc_raise_p). array_fade_seasons: a standing array left behind loses a level every this many seasons (Formations rule 14, the abode's clock). c1u_capability_15: the extra upkept layer-1 density cap where Capability #15 (Formation Within a Formation) applies. Values are the GDD's guesses for the balance harness.
